A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-tonnikasisters-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Tonnika Sisters]]: The game text changes: “during” is added; “turn during” becomes “of”; “phase, you” becomes “phases,”; “(Sisters are targeted as one character, but require double Force to move.)” is dropped. These are the same words as [[Tonnika Sisters (Decipher Errata 2002)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
